p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend any non-background horizontal run to the right edge in marker color 1.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    for row in out:
        cols = [i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if cols:
            end = max(cols)
            if end < len(row)-1:
                row[end+1:] = [1] * (len(row)-end-1)
    return out
''')
